outcome: Themes related to important aspects of care during childbirth
Sense of coherence related to a positive birth and motherhood experience
cohort: The study included 8401 women who gave birth in Norway between 2013 and 2018, participating in the Babies Born Better online survey.
finding: Norwegian women across all birth settings prioritise maternity care that genuinely integrates socio-cultural and psychological aspects with physical and clinical factors.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from women who gave birth between 2013 and 2018.
